gloss: for children; children's; aimed at children

definitions.gloss: for children; children's; aimed at children
definitions.explanation: Designed or intended for school-age children, roughly ages 6-12. Used to describe books, programs, facilities, and events targeting this age group.

examples.japanese: {児童向|じどうむ}けの{本|ほん}をたくさん{読|よ}んだ。
examples.english: I read many books for children.

examples.japanese: この{番組|ばんぐみ}は{児童向|じどうむ}けに{作|つく}られている。
examples.english: This program is made for children.

examples.japanese: {図書館|としょかん}の{二階|にかい}には{児童向|じどうむ}けのコーナーがあり、{絵本|えほん}や{児童文学|じどうぶんがく}が{豊富|ほうふ}に{揃|そろ}っている。
examples.english: On the second floor of the library there is a children's section, with a rich collection of picture books and children's literature.

notes:
A compound of {児童|じどう} (child, school-age child) and {向|む}け (aimed at, intended for). {児童|じどう} specifically refers to children of elementary school age, as opposed to {幼児|ようじ} (toddlers/preschoolers) or {青少年|せいしょうねん} (youth/teenagers).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {児童向|じどうむ}けの{教材|きょうざい}: teaching materials for children
- {児童向|じどうむ}け{施設|しせつ}: facilities for children
- {児童向|じどうむ}け{番組|ばんぐみ}: children's program
- {児童向|じどうむ}けのワークショップ: workshop for children

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {子|こ}ども{向|む}け: for children — more casual and broader in age range
- {幼児向|ようじむ}け: for toddlers/young children — targets younger children (roughly 0-5)
- {家族向|かぞくむ}け: for families — broader, includes adults and children together
